links.outcome: Hallucination index: share of LLM-quoted source text not matching EHR text
links.effect: Hallucination index for explanations was low; the LLM did not produce text that was not found in EHRs (326 patients, ~1,400 notes).
links.quote: The hallucination index for explanations was low, suggesting that the LLM did not produce text that was not found in EHRs.

unlisted_practices: Automated hallucination score comparing LLM-quoted source text to EHR text for GOC documentation identification

screen.reason: Retrospective feasibility study evaluating GPT-4o to identify goals-of-care documentation in EHR notes and summarize them, measuring accuracy and hallucination index without testing a specific organizational deployment practice.
